category_anchor.interpretation: This is planning arithmetic over a rejected diagnostic D14 category row, not an additive or retained claim. The new all-or-none bundle must be remeasured from D12.

attention_gate_component.contract: Keep the current global or token4 attention arithmetic and F32 context store. Each query-head block loads its F32 gate, evaluates the existing >20/log1p(exp) softplus expression, multiplies the rounded F32 context, and writes the same BF16 gated context. The registered attention then attention_gate chain remains the mandatory fallback.
attention_gate_component.global_geometry: unchanged local256 one block/query-head; target VGPR<=48, scratch0
attention_gate_component.swa_geometry: unchanged local128 token4 exact one block/query-head; target VGPR<=32, dynamic LDS unchanged, scratch0

head_kv_component.contract: Preserve F32 query/key scratch, BF16 K/V, complete KVLiveSpans, and the registered head+writer fallback exactly.
head_kv_component.source: reintroduce the exact 7081f64dc global/SWA D14 siblings

kernel_design.runtime: One default-off session selector resolves all four keys or none. c=1 gfx1100 may execute two fused boundaries; rows>1, gfx1151, key/shape miss, explicit disable, and unsupported capture modes execute the existing four-kernel chain.
kernel_design.synchronization: Both composites are block-local. The two surviving kernel completion boundaries still order head/KV before attention/gate and attention/gate before output projection; no producer counter, cooperative launch, or cross-block barrier is introduced.

lineage.note: Both components are in-tree exact specializations of current Laguna kernels. D14's internal implementation/correctness source is commit 7081f64dc; no external kernel is ported.
